basic_info.description: 2 bedroom 1.5 bathroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 91% Area Median  Income (AMI). Maximum income for 2 people = $109,100; 3 = $122,700; 4 = $136,350, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available through the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions.  Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on 8/14/2024 at 5PM. OPEN HOUSE 7/27/2024 1:30-4:30PM, 7/30/2024 5-7PM, 8/4 3:30-5:30PM.        Fair Housing Opportunity.        Don't miss the opportunity to own this top floor two story condo with zoned heating, newer garbage  disposal, and balcony! Community amenities include a fitness room, bike storage room, community room,  and a community garden. Leased garage parking space available at $50 per month and leased storage unit  available at $30 per month.
